verdict.rationale: Workable ships its own AI agent, so asking whether it can plug in external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Workable acting as an MCP server, which exposes Workable's tools to outside AI assistants. That is a different role and does not show Workable consuming tools from external MCP servers, so there is no evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
